S1.why: Label-first like a price tag under the bracket; 4 CJK plus the digit, inside 6.

S2.why: An invitation with the vocab's item word; colloquial 存 instead of 儲存 keeps a 9-character title warm, not a notice.

S3.s: 你已存滿 %lld 個免費剪切片段，它們會一直免費，照常可以使用。
S3.back: you already saved-full 5 [cl.] free cut-clips, they will always free, as-usual can use.
S3.why: 存滿 (filled up) instead of 用完 (used up), because 用完 sounds as if the items are gone; 你 as in Apple's own Taiwan copy.

S4.s: 你可以免費儲存 %lld 個剪切片段。
S4.why: Plain statement, 儲存 as the save verb; the vocab's '%lld 個剪切片段' count form used whole.

S5.s: 已存 %1$lld 個剪切片段，免費可存 %2$lld 個。
S5.back: already saved 3 [cl.] cut-clips, free can save 5 [cl.].
S5.why: Two short parallel clauses with 存 instead of a fraction; positional forms kept although the order matches.

S6.s: 可儲存 %@ 個剪切片段
S6.why: Bold row line in the vocab's count form, 8 CJK plus the number.

S7.s: 文字剪切片段最多 %@ 個，圖片剪切片段最多 %lld 個。
S7.back: text cut-clips at-most 5,000 [cl.], image cut-clips at-most 500 [cl.].
S7.why: Uses the vocab's two item names, 文字剪切片段 and 圖片剪切片段, in a 最多 X 個 frame repeated on purpose so the two limits line up.

S8.why: Chinese list: 、 between items and 和 before the last, the way Apple Taiwan writes it.

S9.s: 一次購買，登入同一個 Apple 帳號的裝置都能使用。
S9.back: one-time purchase, signed-in same one Apple Account's devices all can use.
S9.why: Reuses the vocab's 登入 Apple 帳號的裝置 phrasing so the account reads the same as in the iCloud setting.

S10.why: 買斷 is the everyday Taiwan and Hong Kong word for a pay-once licence and already says nothing recurring, in 4 characters.

S11.s: 不用訂閱，沒有廣告，也不必註冊。
S11.back: no-need subscribe, not-have ads, also not-must register.
S11.why: Three short spoken clauses, 也 on the last, so it reads like speech instead of a feature checklist.

S12.why: The wording iOS apps in Taiwan use for Restore Purchases; 6 CJK.

S13.why: Same verb as S12; single … (U+2026), which is how Apple's Traditional Chinese UI writes it in controls, not the prose …….

S14.s: 以 %@ 一次解鎖完整版
S14.why: Verb-led button with price first; 完整版 is the name the unlocked app gets everywhere (S15, S23, M1, M5), so the app's name never has to appear.

S16.why: The usual Taiwan and Hong Kong 'maybe later': it puts the decision off instead of refusing.

S17.why: The system's own close label in Traditional Chinese iOS.

S18.back: all space all is yours now
S18.why: 了 marks the change that has just happened; 空間 matches the grid of empty slots filling the sheet. 9 CJK.

S19.s: 謝謝你的購買。這個 App 只有一位開發者，你的支持讓它能繼續更新。
S19.back: thank you for your purchase. this App only has one developer, your support lets it can continue updating.
S19.why: Thanks first, then the one-person fact and something you can see happen (more updates) instead of an abstract 'support'; App is the everyday word in both regions.

S20.s: 歡迎回來，你先前的購買已經回復。
S20.back: welcome back, your earlier purchase already restored.
S20.why: 回復 matches S12 and S13, so the link and the result use the same verb.

S21.s: %2$lld 個免費剪切片段中，已存 %1$lld 個
S21.why: Spoken Chinese puts the whole before the part, so the positional forms swap: total first, then how many are used.

S22.s: 你有 %lld 個剪切片段，最多可存 %@ 個。
S22.back: you have 5 [cl.] cut-clips, at-most can save 5,000 [cl.].
S22.why: Chinese has no plural, so one form works for 1, 2, 5 and 21; the vocab's count form is reused.

S23.s: 已解鎖完整版，最多可儲存 %@ 個剪切片段。
S23.back: already unlocked full-version, at-most can save 5,000 [cl.] cut-clips.
S23.why: Announces the state change with 已, in the same 完整版 and count form as the sheet.

S24.why: States what happened and nothing else, so it carries no blame; 5 CJK.

S25.s: 目前無法連線到 App Store，請稍後再試一次。
S25.back: currently cannot connect to App Store, please later try again once.
S25.why: 連線 is Apple Taiwan's verb for reaching a service; the 請稍後再試 exit is the standard one.

S26.s: App Store 沒有確認這筆購買。
S26.back: App Store did-not confirm this [cl. for transactions] purchase.
S26.why: 筆 is the native classifier for a transaction; it says no more than that, because we do not know whether a charge went through.

S27.s: 此裝置上登入的 Apple 帳號，沒有這個 App 的購買紀錄。
S27.back: this device on signed-in Apple Account, not-have this App's purchase record.
S27.why: 此裝置 avoids Taiwan 這台 vs Hong Kong 這部; 紀錄 is the Taiwan spelling, and the app is called 這個 App, not by name (see report).

S28.s: 免費版可儲存 %lld 個剪切片段。完整版只需解鎖一次，之後想存多少都可以。
S28.back: free-version can save 5 [cl.] cut-clips. full-version only needs unlock once, after-that want save how-many all okay.
S28.why: 免費版 and 完整版 are the pair a Taiwan reader knows; 想存多少都可以 is how a person says 'as many as you like'.

S29.why: A label and a value, the compact form for a subtitle; 6 CJK, and the ASCII slash is how Taiwan UI writes a count.

K1.s: %lld 個免費剪切片段已存滿，點一下解鎖
K1.back: 5 [cl.] free cut-clips already saved-full, tap once unlock
K1.why: 點一下 is Apple Taiwan's tap verb; 存滿 matches S3. About 15 CJK, inside 18.

M1.why: A verb-led command name, like 偏好設定 or 關於 in the Window menu; the same words as S15.

M2.why: M1 as a button, with a single … because it opens a window, as Mac menus write it.

M3.why: A row label that names the thing, using the vocab's item word.

M4.why: A bare number pair, the same form as the S29 value.

M5.why: 已 marks a status that is done; keeps the 完整版 used throughout.

M6.s: 購買一次，即可在 iPhone、iPad 和 Mac 上解鎖完整版。
M6.back: purchase once, then-can on iPhone, iPad and Mac unlock full-version.
M6.why: 即可 is the written link a settings footnote uses; the device list is written as in S8.

M7.s: 已在登入此 Apple 帳號的 iPhone、iPad 和 Mac 上解鎖。
M7.back: already on signed-in this Apple Account's iPhone, iPad and Mac unlocked.
M7.why: Same 登入 Apple 帳號 phrasing as the vocab and S9; a statement of the current state.

M8.s: 你在這個 App 改為免費前就已購買，所以會一直保持解鎖。謝謝你的支持。
M8.back: you before this App changed-to free already purchased, so will always stay unlocked. thank you for your support.
M8.why: Cause and result with 所以 as a person says it, then a short thanks; no name for the app (see report).
